official.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUC provides, in AUC's words, full scholarships and comprehensive support to talented young people from across Africa, starting Spring 2027, enabling them to pursue graduate education while developing leadership potential through leadership development activities, workshops and fieldwork experiences within the global Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program network.
official.program_type: Sponsored (externally funded) graduate fellowship - Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUC
official.english_requirement: Minimum acceptable scores: IELTS Academic 6.5 total with 7.0 writing, TOEFL iBT 79 total with 21 writing, or Cambridge CPE/CAE 176 total. Test results are valid for two years and cannot be considered if they expire before the first day of classes. Degree-seeking applicants below the full-admission score can be provisionally admitted and placed in remedial English modules (ELIN or ENGL), which this fellowship may cover.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a package award, not a cash grant: AUC publishes what it covers (tuition for nine credits per semester, a stipend during fall and spring terms, dorm accommodation, insurance, a laptop, bus or travel allowance, and roundtrip airfare for fellows not already living in Egypt) but no stipend amount, so budget for yourself until the award letter arrives. Applying takes two separate submissions: the AUC graduate application must be in at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline, you then need your AUC student ID (allow five to seven working days) before the second, Mastercard Foundation Scholars application unlocks in Banner Self-Service. Missing either step, or missing the 2 November 2026 close of the Spring 2027 round, ends the bid regardless of your profile. The money rides on performance: you must hold full-time status, keep a 3.2 GPA, take on 12 hours a week of related academic work, and attend the programme's leadership workshops.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A citizen of an African country, age 35 or younger, living in Africa, with a 3.2+ bachelor's record and demonstrable financial need who wants a fully supported master's at AUC in Cairo.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit the AUC graduate application (ApplyWeb) well before 2 November 2026 - it must be on record at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline
Book TOEFL/IELTS early: scores must still be valid on your first day of classes, and provisional admission with remedial English (which this fellowship may fund) is the fallback, not the goal
Line up two recommenders who will upload letters online themselves - letters sent by applicants are not accepted and expire after two consecutive semesters
Assemble transcripts with official stamps and signatures plus proof of degree completion; scanned copies are fine to start, originals only if admitted
After receiving your AUC student ID, create the Banner Self-Service account and complete the separate Mastercard Foundation Scholars application, checking the deadlines page first
Watch for AUC emails requesting additional fellowship paperwork and answer them by the stated deadlines
common_rejection_risks: Completing only the AUC admission application and never submitting the separate fellowship application - admission to AUC does not carry the fellowship
Applying as a transfer student, which the fellowship rules exclude outright
GPA below the published 3.2 minimum on a 4.0 scale, or failing to evidence financial need
Leaving the application fee or English test until the last week and missing the two-weeks-before rule for the admission application
Recommendation letters not actually submitted by the recommenders through the online system before the deadline
Dropping below full-time enrollment or the 3.2 GPA once awarded, which ends the coverage at the semester review
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Anything outside the published coverage: credits beyond the nine tuition-covered credits per semester, summer-session tuition and living costs (the stipend runs only in fall and spring), meals and personal spending, books and materials, Egyptian student visa and residence costs, and airfare for fellows who already live in Egypt.
document_audit: Transcripts must carry official stamps and signatures - plain printouts stall the file
Only online letters of recommendation count; keep your recommenders' contact details current and chase their submissions in the portal
Some programmes (e.g. MBA, finance) recommend GMAT/GRE - optional for admission but useful for fellowship competitiveness
English test scores must remain valid through the first day of classes; unofficial results work only for processing
The Foundation reimburses admission fees only after selection - expect to pay the application fee up front
alerts: The Spring 2027 round closes 2 November 2026; the Fall 2027 cycles (17 January and 6 May 2027) are the next shots if you miss it

AUC's listing targets new graduate degree-seeking students, but the Mastercard Foundation's own FAQ states PhD-level scholarships are not currently offered - doctoral applicants should confirm with mastercardfdn@aucegypt.edu before relying on this fellowship
The Mastercard Foundation warns that Facebook posts recruiting for the programme and charging application fees are fraudulent - apply only through AUC's official pages
Airfare is covered only for fellows not residing in Egypt; Cairo-based applicants pay their own way
Keeping the award is conditional: semester-by-semester academic review, 12 hours per week of related academic work and mandatory attendance at programme workshops
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: ApplyWeb admission application first (at least two weeks early), AUC student ID issued, then the Mastercard Foundation Scholars application in Banner Self-Service, after which a selection committee reviews both files and may request extra paperwork before the award decision.
